summary: Build your dream avatar life world! Explore fun role playing games for girls!
description:
Welcome to Tizi Friends Avatar Life World, a creative avatar world where kids can create characters, explore exciting places, decorate rooms, and make their own stories. Enter the colorful Tizi World and enjoy an open-ended game world filled with pretend play, customization, food, fashion, homes, and friendship adventures.

Create your own avatar, choose fun outfits, explore different locations, interact with objects, and decide what happens next. In Tizi Friends, every place gives kids another opportunity to imagine and create their own stories.

Create Your Own Avatar

Design an avatar that matches your imagination. Choose different hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and looks to create unique characters.

Create multiple avatars and bring your avatar life stories to life. Dress them up, make new friends, and take your characters with you while exploring the different locations across Tizi World.

Explore Your Avatar World

Discover a colorful avatar world filled with interactive locations, rooms, shops, food, fashion, and activities.

Move your characters between locations, interact with different objects, and create your own everyday adventures. Your avatar life world is yours to explore, so every story can be different.

Build friendships, create families, decorate spaces, and imagine your own avatar world life stories.

Make Pizza at the Pizza Shop

Feeling hungry? Visit the pizza restaurant with your Tizi Friends and become a pizza maker.

Choose your favorite toppings, prepare your pizza, bake it in the oven, and serve it to your characters. Create different food stories inside your growing game world.

Create Ice Cream Treats

Visit the ice cream parlor and prepare colorful frozen treats.

Choose flavors, add toppings, make cones or sundaes, and serve your creations to your avatar characters. Turn the ice cream shop into your own pretend-play adventure.

Design Hats and Dress Up

Visit the hat shop and create something new for your characters.

Choose different colors, patterns, and accessories to design unique hats. Combine them with outfits and create your own fashion style for every avatar in your world.

Explore the Mansion and Apartment

There are plenty of places to discover in the Tizi Friends avatar world.

Explore the bedroom, kitchen, living room, balcony, pool area, and other interactive spaces. Move objects, arrange furniture, prepare meals, host pretend parties, or create fun family and friendship stories.

Create a home that matches the avatar life you imagine.

Decorate and Create Your Own Stories

Use furniture, decorations, characters, food, clothes, and interactive objects to create your own scenes.

Turn everyday locations into imaginative adventures. Kids can decide where their characters go, what they wear, who they meet, and what happens next.

The open-ended avatar life world encourages creativity, storytelling, exploration, and pretend play.

Discover Avatar World City Life

Explore shops, homes, food locations, and activity areas while creating your own avatar world city life.

Each location offers something different to discover. Create characters, visit different places, interact with objects, and build stories as you explore.

Play Your Way in Tizi Friends

There is no single way to play. Kids can:

Create and customize an avatar
Make different Tizi Friends
Explore an avatar world
Dress up characters
Discover shops and homes
Make pizzas and ice cream
Design hats and accessories
Decorate rooms
Interact with different objects
Create family and friendship stories
Build their own pretend-play adventures

If you enjoy creative world games, character customization, pretend play, and storytelling, there is always something new to imagine.

Enter Tizi World, create your characters, explore your game world, and start your next adventure in Tizi Friends Avatar Life World!
